title: Captions
summary: The caption is the headline: one line of narration at the top, revealed word by word out of a soft blur, key words bold white, italic serif or on a blue highlight.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "top-line", "captionPlacement": "fixed"}. Per shot: "emphasis": {"word": 1|2|3} (bold, serif, blue highlight) and "tone": "light" on light shots. Styles: library/themes/minimal/captions/styles.js.

items.name: Top line
items.description: One line at the top, word by word; emphasis levels bold / serif / blue highlight; dark ink on light shots.
